svg.title: SDEC consolidated integration requirements: consolidated journey diagram
svg.text: v0.2 (draft), 1 October 2026. Create Thread, External User Document Upload and External User Submission, with NRS and eDMS legs. Step numbers match the source sequence diagrams; requirement detail is in the workbook.
Handoff: recipient asked to provide documents
Handoff: documents staged, user submits response
Box colour shows the system that performs the stage
Line style shows the integration type
